about.story3: Today, miMesa serves thousands of guests daily, helping restaurants reclaim their time and ownership of their customer relationships.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.content:
This privacy policy explains how **Lopes2tech** ("we", "us", "our"), operating the miMesa platform (mimesa.ch and app.mimesa.ch), collects, uses, and protects your personal data.

We are committed to protecting your privacy in accordance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (revDSG/nFADP) and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.heading: 2. Data Controller
sections.content:
The data controller responsible for processing your personal data is:

**Lopes2tech**
Switzerland
Email: privacy@mimesa.ch

sections.heading: 3. Data We Collect
sections.content: We collect the following categories of personal data:
list: Account information: name, email address, restaurant name, and contact details
Reservation data: guest names, party sizes, dates, times, and special requests
Usage data: pages visited, features used, and interaction patterns
Device data: browser type, operating system, and IP address
Communication data: messages sent through our contact form or support channels
sections.afterList: We do not collect sensitive personal data such as health information, religious beliefs, or political opinions.

sections.heading: 4. How We Use Your Data
sections.content: We process your personal data for the following purposes:
list: Providing and improving our reservation management services
Processing and managing restaurant reservations
Sending booking confirmations and reminders
Providing customer support
Analyzing usage patterns to improve our platform
Ensuring the security and integrity of our services
Complying with legal obligations

sections.heading: 5. Data Storage and Security
sections.content:
All data is stored exclusively on servers located in **Switzerland**. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

These measures include encryption in transit (TLS/SSL), encryption at rest, regular security audits, and access controls limiting data access to authorized personnel only.

sections.heading: 6. Data Sharing
sections.content: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data. We may share data with:
list: Service providers who assist in operating our platform (hosting, email delivery, payment processing)
Legal authorities when required by law or to protect our rights
Third parties with your explicit consent
sections.afterList: All service providers are contractually bound to process data in accordance with Swiss and EU data protection standards.

sections.heading: 7. Your Rights
sections.content: Under the revDSG and GDPR, you have the following rights:
list: Right of access: Request a copy of your personal data
Right to rectification: Request correction of inaccurate data
Right to erasure: Request deletion of your personal data
Right to data portability: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
Right to object: Object to processing based on legitimate interests
Right to withdraw consent: Withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent
sections.afterList: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at privacy@mimesa.ch.

sections.heading: 8. Cookies
sections.content:
We use essential cookies required for the functioning of our platform. We do not use tracking cookies or third-party advertising cookies.

Analytics data is collected through **Vercel Analytics**, which uses privacy-friendly, cookieless analytics that do not track individual users across sites.

sections.heading: 9. Data Retention
sections.content: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, or as required by law. When data is no longer needed, it is securely deleted or anonymized.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

sections.heading: 11. Contact
sections.content:
If you have questions about this privacy policy or our data practices, please contact us at:

**Lopes2tech**
Email: privacy@mimesa.ch

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing or using the miMesa platform (mimesa.ch and app.mimesa.ch), operated by **Lopes2tech** ("we", "us", "our"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, you may not use our services.

sections.heading: 2. Description of Service
sections.content: miMesa is a restaurant reservation management platform that provides tools for online bookings, table management, guest CRM, waitlist management, and analytics. The service is offered as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution.

sections.heading: 3. Account Registration
sections.content: To use miMesa, you must create an account and provide accurate, complete information. You are responsible for:
list: Maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials
All activities that occur under your account
Notifying us immediately of any unauthorized access
Ensuring all information provided is accurate and up to date

sections.heading: 4. Acceptable Use
sections.content: You agree to use miMesa only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these terms. You may not:
list: Use the service for any illegal or unauthorized purpose
Attempt to gain unauthorized access to our systems or other users' accounts
Interfere with or disrupt the service or servers
Upload malicious code, viruses, or harmful content
Resell, redistribute, or sublicense the service without permission
Use automated systems to access the service without our consent

sections.heading: 5. Pricing and Payment
sections.content:
miMesa offers multiple pricing plans as displayed on our pricing page. Prices are in CHF (Swiss Francs) and exclude applicable taxes (VAT).

Subscription fees are billed monthly in advance. You may upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period.

We reserve the right to modify our pricing with 30 days' advance notice.

sections.heading: 6. Data Ownership
sections.content:
You retain full ownership of all data you input into miMesa, including guest information, reservation data, and restaurant configuration. We do not claim any ownership rights over your data.

You grant us a limited license to process your data solely for the purpose of providing and improving our services.

sections.heading: 7. Service Availability
sections.content:
We strive to maintain 99.9% uptime for our services. However, we do not guarantee uninterrupted access and are not liable for temporary unavailability due to:

Scheduled maintenance (with advance notice), force majeure events, third-party service disruptions, or circumstances beyond our reasonable control.

sections.heading: 8. Intellectual Property
sections.content:
The miMesa platform, including its design, code, features, and branding, is the intellectual property of Lopes2tech. You may not copy, modify, or reverse-engineer any part of the service.

Your use of miMesa does not grant you any intellectual property rights in the service beyond the right to use it according to these terms.

sections.heading: 9. Limitation of Liability
sections.content:
To the maximum extent permitted by Swiss law, Lopes2tech shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the service.

Our total liability for any claim arising from these terms shall not exceed the amount you paid us in the 12 months preceding the claim.

sections.heading: 10. Termination
sections.content:
Either party may terminate this agreement at any time. Upon termination:

Your access to the service will be revoked at the end of your current billing period. You may export your data before termination. We will delete your data within 30 days of termination, unless retention is required by law.

sections.heading: 11. Governing Law
sections.content: These terms are governed by the laws of **Switzerland**. Any disputes arising from these terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the Canton of Zurich, Switzerland.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to Terms
sections.content: We may modify these terms from time to time. Material changes will be communicated via email or through the platform with at least 30 days' notice. Continued use of the service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

sections.heading: 13. Contact
sections.content:
For questions about these terms, please contact us at:

**Lopes2tech**
Email: legal@mimesa.ch
